one_line: Team messaging and collaboration platform with a very broad REST API, Events API, webhooks, and Socket Mode for building bots and apps.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with scoped tokens (bot + user tokens); apps created free in seconds at api.slack.com/apps; Slack CLI and Bolt SDKs available.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve app creation; works on free plans. No approval needed beyond installing the app to a workspace.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across chat, conversations, users, files, workflows, admin, and audit; plus Events API and WebSocket/Socket Mode.
api_surface.webhook_note: Incoming/outgoing webhooks plus Events API subscriptions for granular event delivery.

existing_mcp.note: Official Slack MCP server exists; numerous community MCP servers also available.
